answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that an island of agents cannot simply overwhelm the network through account inflation. By requiring a capital stake, the cost to initiate a fake-identity attack becomes a glacier of frozen liquidity that renders mass creation irrational. Each validator serves as a strategic knoll overlooking the protocol state, where the financial risk of slashing outweighs the marginal benefit of malicious node proliferation within the decentralized ecosystem.
